pairs.distinction: Vary whether connection styling reflects the authoritative operation, not whether it uses a dot.
Vary whether a displayed percentage has a comparable, nonzero baseline.
Vary the presence and persistence of simulation context, not the use of synthetic records.
Vary the user task while preserving an otherwise sound overview layout.
Vary a concrete readability defect while keeping familiar visual choices constant.
Vary whether a screenshot claim is refuted by supplied source evidence or merely lacks verification.

assess: Identifies the evidenced false connection claim, including the pending/failed states.
Connects the cue to the actual account and operation state; checks a successful connection as the valid control.
Does not ban dots, add a new backend or turn supplied source evidence into an executed transition.
Preserves the useful indicator; a familiar dot does not establish a defect.
Accepts the supplied state evidence within its scope without certifying unrelated runtime behavior.
Does not require removal of all dots or a decorative redesign.
Rejects the unsupported percentage without rejecting the supported current amount.
Distinguishes missing and zero baselines; does not replace either with zero growth.
Proposes an honest unavailable/non-percentage treatment and checks a known nonzero comparable baseline.
Preserves the supported +20% comparison and its period/population meaning.
Does not demand that valid comparison data or the chart be deleted.
Avoids a universal method paragraph on every card or a new analytics pipeline.
Identifies that the presentation wrongly attributes synthetic events to the user account.
Keeps a useful preview by making its simulation context clear rather than requiring real transactions.
Carries that context into an independently delivered export and checks a labelled demo as the control.
Keeps the clearly identified synthetic data and useful composition.
Does not require real data, delete the demo, or repeat the label on every row.
Does not call the prototype a verified live payment implementation.
Locates the task-priority and space-allocation mismatch, not an invented data defect.
Prioritizes the queue or an equally useful way to reach and act on overdue tickets without mandating a new template.
Checks the composed task at the supported viewport and preserves useful overview information at an appropriate priority.
Recognizes analysis and monitoring as sufficient purposes without immediate action buttons.
Preserves justified repeated cards and charts rather than forcing a queue-first redesign.
Does not invent an operational workflow or a one-button-per-chart requirement.
Identifies the evidenced identity/readability defect and a scoped layout or disclosure repair.
Preserves the accepted palette and font unless evidence establishes a related problem.
Does not infer AI authorship or ban cards and gradients.
Allows a clean scoped assessment instead of inventing novelty requirements.
Does not reject familiar typography, cards or gradients by syntax or alleged authorship.
Qualifies the conclusion to the supplied evidence rather than claiming new visual or assistive tests.
Identifies the evidence-backed mismatch between popularity wording and recommendation meaning.
Suggests truthful recommendation wording or another appropriately scoped correction without inventing usage statistics.
Does not demand removal of a useful recommendation or a new usage-tracking service.
Marks the basis unverified and names the evidence needed to check population and measurement period.
Does not call the badge fabricated or delete it because the screenshot cannot prove its claim.
Separates visible meaning from unavailable factual and runtime verification.
